name: check
run: sh app/check.sh lint && sh app/check.sh test

name: deliver
run: git add -A app && { git diff --cached --quiet; code=$?; case $code in 0) : ;; 1) git commit -qm '<ticket>' -m 'Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>' ;; *) exit "$code" ;; esac; } && git push -u origin HEAD && GH_REPO=dbaz-orisha/sdd-workshop sh graph/pr.sh <ticket> <run>
